description: x402 paid seal-registry verification; use only after separate payment authorization, not for free lookup. Arguments that cannot be a seal UUID are HTTP 400 before payment. Empty arguments are unpaid HTTP 402. Paid calls are answered from the seal registry at $0.05 USDC on Base. For free verification use verify_record.

sealId.description: Required seal UUID. productId and serial are not registry keys.

tier.description: Signal tier. ping: registry existence only. verify (default): signature and validity baseline. evidence: the baseline plus a SHA-256 digest of the returned answer. The HTTP 402 quote states the exact price. No tier claims real-world authenticity.

name: verify
